en: An old tinted postcard view of a wide, rough dirt road running between high earthen/stone ramparts and fortification walls. Long, low military barracks and buildings stretch into the distance, with mountains capped with snow in the background. The scene depicts a military encampment on or beside old Venetian fortifications. At the bottom margin there is printed caption text along with an editor/photographer credit and a Greek website watermark over the image.
